name: hyperliquid
description: Hyperliquid full-stack — backend agent signing, all L1+user actions, copy-trade live engine, indexes, vaults, MCP tool server

layout.src/mod.py: Python orchestrator (serve/kill/status/forward, plus typed wrappers for every endpoint)
layout.src/api/: Rust REST API (axum, tokio) — backend agent signer, action signing, /exchange poster, live engine, MCP tool server
layout.src/api/src/mcp.rs: MCP tool registry + JSON-RPC dispatch — one schema for the mod fn surface and the MCP tool list
layout.src/app/: Next.js 14 app (copy-trade UI, indexes, vaults, live panel)

mcp.transport: streamable-http (JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per POST) + stdio (`hyperliquid-api --stdio`)
mcp.auth: optional — same Authorization: Bearer <mod protocol token> as the REST API; public tools work signed-out
mcp.docs: Every MCP tool fronts a mod-protocol fn from `fns` and executes as a loopback call to its REST route, so the auth gate applies unchanged. GET /mcp/schema publishes the tool → fn → route mapping.
